items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: And Big Bill and some other guy was with us who was going to record

ctx.x: And Big Bill and some other guy was with us who was going to record, and he said, well, you take them down there and start their recording, and you do your single, and by that time, I'll have this guy and go to the rehearsal, get one little rehearsal in with him, and I'll bring all the rest of the men down, and we'll have it sold up for the four days. Big Bill played, the other guy played, and he comes to me to play my time. I sit down at the piano and hit the piano, and I couldn't talk about the whistle.
